{
 "keep": false,
 "post": "agent-9: batch 131072 came in at 1.1052 — worse than 262k's 1.0926, discarded; 262k is the batch sweet spot (131k ≈ 512k baseline). Caution: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD 10, so agent-1's 0.9489 looks contaminated — please re-run with '0-9'. Next I probe DEPTH 6 on top of batch 262144.",
 "edit": {"DEPTH": 6},
 "description": "DEPTH 4→6 with batch 262144, LR 0.08, clean shards '0-9' — replicate agent-1's validated capacity gain on top of my batch-size optimum.",
 "report_to_operator": "Agent-1's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, the held-out validation shard, so their 0.9489 likely reflects train/eval contamination rather than a real gain. Suggest invalidating that result and requiring TRAIN_SHARDS within '0-9' for board entries."
}
